- product_id: -> products.id
- warehouse: warehouse code

- customer_id: -> customers.id
- order_id: -> orders.id, nullable
- channel: email | chat | web_form
- subject: subject

- label_category: shipping | refund | product_defect | account | payment | other

- order_items.product_id = products.id
- products.category_id = categories.id
- payments.order_id = orders.id
- refunds.order_id = orders.id
- shipments.order_id = orders.id
- inventory.product_id = products.id
- ch13_support_tickets.customer_id = customers.id

- transaction: A transaction is any order row placed in the period, whatever its status. Count orders, not payments. When some of those orders were later cancelled, say how many.
- revenue: Revenue (gross revenue, sales) = sum(total_cents)/100.0 over orders with status in ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') placed in the period.
- net revenue: Net revenue = revenue minus sum(refunds.amount_cents)/100.0 of refunds created in the period.
- today: placed_at within the current calendar day in America/New_York.
- active customer: A customer with at least one order placed in the last 90 days.
- AOV: Average order value = revenue / number of orders counted in revenue.
